question: For which of the following countries does tennis player Novak Djokovic play?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Serbia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Novak Djokovic** is a** Serbian professional tennis player.**
 
• He is presently ranked** world No. 7** in singles by the union of Tennis Professionals.
 
• Djokovic is the **only male player to win 3 consecutive Australian Open** trophies through the Open Era, which he has done twice **(2011–13 and 2019–21)**. 
 
• Djokovic is the second of only two male players in the past to win a **Grand Slam singles trophy** nine or more times, the other being Nadal **(14 French Opens).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gilles Simon** is a French professional tennis player. 
 
• **Dominic Thiem** is an **Austrian professional tennis player** who has reached multiple Grand Slam finals and is presently considered **one of the best clay-court players on the ATP Tour**.
 
• **Rafael Nadal** is considered as the most significant **Spanish** player of all time.​
